children: AltLayer has a supply unlock scheduled for January 2027 that releases 595.83 million ALT to ecosystem, team and treasury wallets. The unlocked amount represents 7.83% of the token's circulating supply.
The release adds a large amount of liquid ALT in one step. Those tokens become available for recipients to sell, creating downward pressure on the token as the supply available for trading expands.

title: AltLayer: unlocks 595.83 million ALT for ecosystem, team and treasury - Jan 2027
